highlights.title: Cari & Ganti semua file
highlights.text: File .py (juga .ts, .tsx, .jsx, .java, .kt, .gradle, .properties, .toml, .csv) sekarang ikut dicari saat kolom ekstensi kosong.

highlights.title: Hasil pencarian tidak lagi basi
highlights.text: Cache isi file dibatasi 30 detik dan daftar file 60 detik.

highlights.title: Ganti per baris di mode regex
highlights.text: Sekarang benar untuk pola dengan lookahead atau anchor, dan mendukung $1, $& serta $<nama>.

highlights_en.title: Find & Replace across all files
highlights_en.text: .py files (and .ts, .tsx, .jsx, .java, .kt, .gradle, .properties, .toml, .csv) are now searched when the extension field is empty.

highlights_en.title: Search results are no longer stale
highlights_en.text: The file content cache is limited to 30 seconds and the file list to 60 seconds.

highlights_en.title: Per-line replace in regex mode
highlights_en.text: Now correct for patterns with lookahead or anchors, and supports $1, $& and $<name>.
